reviewNotes: Reviewed all 129 exported keys from 20 cards against data/pages28-29-culinary.json source furigana and vocabulary. Sentence questions/explanations and complete procedural/causal answer clauses use 1.0; standalone food names and noun groups use 0.85. Contextual は -> わ selected by exact key and occurrence; lexical はっこう, はたらき, はんのう, はやく, はんい, はな, はったつ, はくはん, ふはい and じょうはつ preserved. Directional/transformation へ -> え only in peptide, alcohol, earlier state, acid and cooking destination inputs; lexical へんか retained. Object を -> お. pH explicitly rendered ぴーえいち; original lookup unchanged. Katakana converted preserving long vowels/gemination: あみのさん, ぺぷちど, あるこーる, こく, ぜろ. Vocabulary readings checked for 麹, 酵母, 乳酸菌, 酢酸菌, 糖化 and 香気成分. Final fragment punctuation added. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. Text review only; audible articulation and pitch accent not verified.
